# T-2: Split parseEvaluationResponse into article and requirement parsers

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Replace parseEvaluationResponse with parseGuardrailArticleEvaluation and parseImplRequirementEvaluation. Update buildGuardrailPromptFromFiltered's call site to use the article parser; update buildImplCheckPrompt's call site to use the requirement parser. Add named exports for both functions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- src/flow/lib/run-gate.js exports parseGuardrailArticleEvaluation(rawResponse, knownIds) and parseImplRequirementEvaluation(rawResponse, knownIds).
- Both functions preserve the existing known-id invariants: reject unknown id, reject duplicate id, reject missing id.
- Article parser additionally enforces: FAIL with violations[] >=1 and non-empty target/where/why_violates per entry, no duplicate (guardrail_id, target, where) triples; PASS/SKIP with non-empty reason and no violations field.
- On invariant violation: throw EvaluationSchemaError with a message identifying the offending entry and field.
- parseEvaluationResponse export is removed.

## Implementation Notes
Share helpers (extractJsonCandidate, EvaluationSchemaError) between both parsers. Article parser: branch on result, validate FAIL → violations / PASS|SKIP → reason. Requirement parser: keep current logic verbatim aside from name. Update parent: parseGuardrailArticleEvaluation also returns the FAIL `reason` field synthesized in T-3 (i.e. T-3's derived-reason logic lives inside the article parser).

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for each parser: parity with old parser on requirement-style inputs (parseImplRequirementEvaluation regression), and full rejection-case matrix for parseGuardrailArticleEvaluation (10+ cases per R3).
